angle_1_platform_dna.label: Platform DNA Extraction
angle_1_platform_dna.question: What does this week's code/findings reveal about how CDS builds things? Does the implementation match the stated DNA?
this_week_findings: DNA states: 'mechanical enforcement over convention' — but 40% of Phase 0 rules are convention-dependent. Gap: GOV-001/002/003/004.
DNA states: 'immutable audit trail' — but updateRecord() overwrites. Gap: DATA-002.
DNA states: 'governed vocabulary' — but vocabulary set is hardcoded, not live. Gap: GOV-003.
DNA-CONSISTENT: CR-ID format, 5-source-path architecture, 8 input types — all correctly implemented.
DNA-CONSISTENT: CSPS cleansing applied before adoption. All 6 CSPS patterns marked INCOMING-CLEARED.
angle_1_platform_dna.dna_score: 6/10 — Architecture matches DNA. Enforcement does not yet.

angle_2_prevention.label: Prevention-First Creation (HARDWIRED)
angle_2_prevention.question: For each new thing built this week, was PREVENTION built in from the start or bolted on after?
this_week_findings: PREVENTION MISSING: Authentication. SEC-002 is a root-level gap. Actor identity must be hardwired as the FIRST middleware layer. Not an afterthought.
PREVENTION MISSING: Injection scan on clarification endpoint (SYS-007). Prevention was applied to initial input but not to the secondary round.
PREVENTION MISSING: Path traversal in getRecord() (SEC-003). Input to file path must be sanitized at function entry, not assumed clean.
PREVENTION APPLIED: Injection scan on classify endpoint — correctly prevents payload-level attacks.
PREVENTION APPLIED: RULE-QUAR auto-applied to external paths — correctly prevents unvetted external content from reaching AI.
PREVENTION RULE FOR NEXT BUILD: Every endpoint must have: (1) authentication check, (2) input validation schema, (3) injection scan applied to ALL string inputs including secondary rounds.
angle_2_prevention.hardwired_rule_for_next_session: Before writing any new route: write the auth middleware and schema validation FIRST. Code the handler second.

angle_3_orchestration.label: Post-Implementation Check (Smart Orchestrator)
angle_3_orchestration.question: What automated checks should fire after each implementation scope to catch the issues found this week before audit?
this_week_findings: CHECK-01: After any new route: verify auth middleware is present and enforced (not just imported).
CHECK-02: After any file I/O: verify no synchronous calls on hot paths (grep for readFileSync/writeFileSync in request handlers).
CHECK-03: After any rule implementation: verify rule checks a live source, not a hardcoded value.
CHECK-04: After any data write: verify immutability (no update/overwrite on governance records).
CHECK-05: After any UI page: verify result states include actionable next-steps for the user, not just classification data.
angle_3_orchestration.orchestrator_model: SONNET (not Opus — per Yariv instruction and PARK-020726-003)
angle_3_orchestration.check_trigger: After each scope completion (not just at sprint end)
